processRecovery.title: Earlier process records
processRecovery.intro: CCCC couldn't confirm that the work behind these records has ended. After you handle them, Voice and the Secretary still check their other conditions when they start.
processRecovery.empty: No earlier processes are waiting for review.

kinds.process_group: A group of old child processes CCCC protected
kinds.launch_intent: A launch with an unconfirmed result: it may not have started, or work may already be running
kinds.opaque_evidence: A record file that couldn't be parsed; it may hold several entries, and its contents weren't read

reasons.launch_incomplete: This launch didn't record a complete process identity, so its result is unconfirmed.
reasons.legacy_identity: An older record format without the identity needed to check it.
reasons.identity_unconfirmed: The identity is missing, unreadable, inconsistent, or not enough to prove ownership.
reasons.foreign_namespace: The record belongs to another PID or time namespace and can't be checked here.
reasons.origin_unknown: CCCC can't tell which boot or namespace the record came from.
reasons.cleanup_unconfirmed: CCCC can't yet confirm whether the related work has ended.
reasons.evidence_invalid: A record was read but couldn't be parsed safely.
reasons.members_unconfirmed: This process group may still have members; their ownership or exit isn't confirmed.
reasons.signal_failed: A justified termination signal didn't succeed.
reasons.evidence_unreadable: A related record couldn't be read or verified.

processRecovery.acceptRisk: Once accepted, CCCC stops waiting for it to end. If it's still running, it may keep working locally, for example changing workspace files or documents, or sending requests to a provider that cost money; what exactly it's doing is unknown. Remote work may also continue after local cleanup.
processRecovery.acceptRiskOpaque: This file's contents couldn't be read, and it may stand for more than one process. Accepting takes on all the unknown risk behind this file and removes it.
processRecovery.stillPending: Still waiting; the record was updated.
